title: GoThru Photographer API Go Project Report

issues.display_title: Issue #118: Update Image Processing Submission Validation for Pay as You Go Accounts
issues.main_description_html:
• improve website inputs validation at Image Processing submission is only for non Pay as you go accounts
  • Set Website Profile data https://360photographers.org/photographer/youcef-pnl-e3lc to null

Result by Developer

The fix for this is in the frontend, and no backend or data change is needed.

Why the website showed: the profile page made it up. /photographer/youcef-pnl-e3lc already returns "website": null from the API (subscription 100, Pay as you go), but the frontend fell back to https://<slug>-360.com whenever a profile had no website, so it displayed youcef-pnl-e3lc-360.com. Every profile without a website, paid or not, showed a fake link like that.

The two checklist items:

  • Website validation for Pay as you go: it's already enforced in two places. The profile update here (updatePhotographerProfile.go) rejects a website unless the subscription is Basic, Pro or Agency, and the dashboard hides the website field for Pay as you go accounts. The apply/submission endpoint doesn't accept a website at all.
  • Set the website for youcef-pnl-e3lc to null: it's already null in the database.

Fix: GoThruMedia/gothru-photographer-v2#95 (PR GoThruMedia/gothru-photographer-v2#96, released in GoThruMedia/gothru-photographer-v2#97). The Website row only appears when the profile actually has a website. It's merged to master and will show on 360photographers.org after the next frontend deploy.
